title: Classic Sword Blocking
description: Brings back the classic sword blocking mechanic for Minecraft 1.21.1. Blocking with a sword reduces incoming damage by 50%. If a shield is equipped, the shield's blocking behavior takes priority.
body:
# Classic Sword Blocking

Miss the old combat mechanics? Classic Sword Blocking brings back the iconic ability to block with swords to Minecraft 1.21.1.

When holding the block button while using a sword, incoming damage is reduced by 50%, recreating the classic defensive playstyle from earlier versions of the game. To maintain compatibility and balance, if the player has a shield equipped, the shield's blocking mechanics will always take priority over sword blocking.

## Features
Restores the classic sword blocking mechanic.
Reduces incoming damage by 50% while blocking.
Shields automatically take priority when equipped.
Designed specifically for Minecraft 1.21.1.
Lightweight and straightforward implementation.
Preserves the nostalgic feel of classic combat while maintaining modern gameplay compatibility.
